recipe_desc: Mid-cycle underwrite: normalized operating margin on a mid-cycle revenue base, valued at an exit EV/LTM-EBITDA multiple; reward/risk measured at SPOT.
spot_source: Polygon EOD daily close 2026-07-20 (live; 2026-07-21 has not settled)

d_and_a.source: committed anchor block — EDGAR companyfacts dep_amort (combined)

net_debt.basis: NET CASH (negative net debt), lease-inclusive, latest 10-Q
net_debt.source: EDGAR: total debt 165 + finance leases 0 + operating leases 123 − cash 1,037 ($M) = −749.016; 10-Q acc 0001352010-26-000029. Equity = EV − (−749.016), i.e. the cash is ADDED — reproduced against the committed anchor's $306.05/sh before this run

diluted_shares.basis: diluted weighted-average, latest 10-Q (anchor stores the raw count 54,183,000 — converted to MILLIONS for this block's unit contract)

cash_interest.basis: FY2025 cash interest PAID (cross-check input only; EPAM is net-cash with $165M total debt, so interest is immaterial)
cash_interest.source: EDGAR companyfacts us-gaap InterestPaidNet, FY2025 — 10-K acc 0001352010-26-000015

cash_tax_rate.basis: EDGAR-DERIVED FY2025 effective rate (NOT an analyst assumption): income tax expense 127.946 ÷ pretax income 505.624 = 25.30%; cross-check only, does not touch value/share

bear.reason: Secular case: AI substitution erodes the labour-arbitrage model; revenue -10% from the trailing twelve months (carrying the negative forward revision breadth, FQ3 0 up / 14 down, rather than assuming it reverses); margin below the FY25 worst (9.53%) as pricing grinds — floored by the variable-cost model, not collapsed; the multiple holds near the post-2022 trough (range low 4.26x, current 4.87x at the 2.6th percentile) — a secular decline earns no re-rating. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

base.reason: Margin is the post-2022 regime median of 11.10% less a ~60bps trajectory haircut: the regime's most recent year (FY25, 9.53%) is its worst and revision breadth is 0 up / 14 down, so the live-regime median likely overstates the forward mid-cycle. Explicitly not the 10-year blend (11.9%, which straddles the 2022 break), not the pre-war level (13.27%, a regime no longer representative), and not the consensus recovery (~15.6% operating income — the Street's base case is our bull). Revenue is consensus FY26E. The multiple sits below the 15.16x post-2022 median: the AI-substitution question earns a durable discount even at mid-cycle. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

bull.reason: The cyclical air-pocket resolves: the delivery rebuild completes and margin recovers toward but below the pre-war median (13.27%) and well below consensus (~15.6%); revenue is consensus FY27E; the multiple moves toward but stays below the post-2022 75th percentile (20.09x). [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

revenue.method: Legs are set on the consensus path: base is consensus FY26E, bull is consensus FY27E, and bear is the trailing twelve months less ~10%, carrying the negative forward revision breadth (FQ3 0 up / 14 down) forward rather than assuming it reverses. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

margin.method: Modelled on regime-split operating-margin statistics (post-2022 window; operating income divided by the ASC-606 revenue tag, with annual filing points filtered to 350-380 day durations so no quarter is mistaken for a year): base is the post-2022 median of 11.10% less a ~60bps trajectory haircut; bear sits below the regime's worst year (FY25, 9.53%); bull recovers toward but below the pre-war median (13.27%, a regime no longer representative). The 10-year blend (11.90%) is explicitly not used — it straddles the 2022 break and describes neither regime. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

multiple.method: Chosen against the regime-split TEV/LTM-EBITDA trading range (38 quarterly closes): base sits below the post-2022 median (15.16x) as an analyst discount for the unresolved AI-substitution question; bear near the post-2022 trough; bull toward but below the post-2022 75th percentile (20.09x). The full-blend median (22.41x) is not used — it is a pre-2022 bubble-era statistic. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]
